answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Refundable entry stake: each identity locks 33 POA that vests back in slices across 12 epochs, only while its grading record stays clean; one confirmed junk verdict freezes the remainder. Running 340 fakes locks 11220 POA for months. Locking capital for months is a cost no emission rate repays. The gale of the design is public, the dune of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the shale of honest work is what finally pays. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
